pattern: Intake of check-out works on a void property: maintenance provider assigned, estimate not yet requested
notes: Unmutated source history (49 events); the Recorded action marker sits on event 003, so the agent sees events 001-002: the manager's request for an estimate for six check-out items after the tenant vacated, and 'Maintenance provider assigned'. The recorded next action (event 003) is the agency's email to the contractor asking for an estimate, with the check-out report attached. attachment-02-estimate.pdf is left out of this folder: the history never links it, so the loader would show it as having come with the request, which would put a finished estimate in front of the agent before anyone has been asked to quote. attachment-01 (linked from event 003), -03 (event 006) and -04 (event 045) stay hidden by the loader. Expected: ask the assigned provider to quote each item, access through the agency's keys, hold for the quote with a review date; no works instructed, no tenant contacted, no escalation.
